name: ira-agent
description: Agente local para análisis automático de accesibilidad y generación de informe IRA automático.

scripts.audit:scenario:auth: node -e "const required=['IRA_AUDIT_USER','IRA_AUDIT_PASSWORD'];const missing=required.filter((name)=>!process.env[name]);if(missing.length){console.error('Faltan variables de entorno: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1);}" && tsx src/index.ts --config scenarios/authenticated.example.json
scripts.audit:scenario:auth:private: node -e "const required=['IRA_AUDIT_USER','IRA_AUDIT_PASSWORD'];const missing=required.filter((name)=>!process.env[name]);if(missing.length){console.error('Faltan variables de entorno: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1);}" && IRA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS=true tsx src/index.ts --config scenarios/authenticated.example.json
scripts.audit:scenario:auth:mock: node -e "const required=['IRA_AUDIT_USER','IRA_AUDIT_PASSWORD'];const missing=required.filter((name)=>!process.env[name]);if(missing.length){console.error('Faltan variables de entorno: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1);}" && IRA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS=true tsx src/index.ts --config scenarios/authenticated.localhost.example.json
